developmentOnlyExceptions.reason: Permitted by the request for development-only dependencies; a package carrying it MUST NOT appear in a runtime graph.

Data licence of the SPDX data packages that license-checker-rseidelsohn and spdx-satisfies bring in (spdx-exceptions, and spdx-ranges' "(MIT AND CC-BY-3.0)"); development graph only, so it is never distributed.
Data licence of caniuse-lite, reached only through the frontend build tooling (browserslist); development graph only.
Public-domain dedication of spdx-license-ids, reached only through license-checker-rseidelsohn; development graph only.

source: Request, Success criteria 11: MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0 and 0BSD, with MPL-2.0 allowed for development-only dependencies. BlueOak-1.0.0 was added from the installed tree: it is a permissive, OSI-approved licence carried by jackspeak, minipass, package-json-from-dist and path-scurry, which reach the runtime graph through glob under @fastify/static. The three further development-only exceptions cover licence data reached only through the licence checker itself and the frontend build tooling; a package carrying one of them still fails in the runtime graph, which is what keeps the exception scoped to development.
